recentItems.title: Skylanders Swap Force 112-Person Tournament: Round 1 Part 1
recentItems.description:
It's time for the overdue 112-person tournament. 

This tournament features all 37 SSA characters and all 75 SSF characters.

Timestamps
0:00 Intro
2:25 Chop Chop vs. Phantom Cynder
4:42 Wrecking Ball vs. Zoo Lou
6:38 Legendary Bash vs. Dark Wash Buckler
9:11 Stink Bomb vs. Dark Mega Ram Spyro
11:00 Hoot Loop vs. Lightcore Bumble Blast
12:40 Punk Shock vs. Fryno
14:40 Kickoff Countdown vs. Boomer
16:18 Legendary Zoo Lou vs. Night Shift(Shutout)
18:15 Wind Up vs. Wham Shell
20:05 Nitro Freeze Blade vs. Legendary Free Ranger(Shutout)
21:38 Heavy Duty Sprocket vs. Quickdraw Rattle Shake
23:42 Cynder vs. Zook
25:03 Rattle Shake vs. Double Trouble
27:17 Dark Ninja Stealth Elf vs. Legendary Chop Chop

Rules
1. Each character will participate in a single-elimination bracket with the winner moving on.
2. For each round, we will play on the same stage to make it fairer.
3. Mulligan- If we feel like we didn't have a fair matchup, or we want a character to get a second chance, we can mulligan for a best 2 out of 3 match.
